entries.source: Electrothermal analogy Electrothermal analogy is a method for calculating thermal systems based on replacing thermal quantities with their electrical analogues. The method is based on the identity of the mathematical apparatus of thermal physics and electrical engineering: the propagation of heat and electric current are described by the same differential equations, while measuring the electrical characteristics of real objects is much simpler.

entries.source: XXI International Zhautykov Olympiad/Theoretical Competition Page 4/7

The first estimate of the Earth age In the 18th century, there lived a famous naturalist, Georges-Louis Leclerc, Count de Buffon (1707- 1788), who was a member of the Paris Academy of Sciences, the French Academy, a member of the Royal Society of London, and also a foreign honorary member of the St. Petersburg Academy of Sciences. He published his works in a multi-volume work, Natural History, in which he attempted to systematize the knowledge gained to that time in a variety of fields of science, and also expressed a number of advanced ideas. His interests included geology, and he was the first to formulate the problem of determining the age of the Earth. In particular, Leclerc developed a hypothesis about the origin of the planets through the collision of celestial bodies, which should have led to their heating and subsequent cooling. It was through the process of temperature change over time that the first estimate of the Earth age in history was obtained.
entries.ko:
지구 나이의 최초 추정

Problem 3. Dirac's monopole (10.0 points)

Introduction A monopole is a hypothetical elementary particle which, unlike all known magnets, is a unipolar magnet. The hypothesis of the existence of magnetic monopoles was put forward by the English physicist Paul Dirac in 1931, and a number of theoretical models have been developed to date of the electromagnetic field in the presence of magnetic charges (monopoles). Note that numerous attempts to experimentally detect magnetic monopoles have been unsuccessful.

초전도체 전자가 고전물리 법칙을 따르고 그 질량을 무시할 수 있다고 하라. 이 부분에서는 개략적인 그래프를 요구한다. 함수를 정확히 계산하거나 수치를 표시할 필요 없이 증가·감소 구간, 극대·극소, 불연속점, 변수가 [[0]]로 갈 때의 거동을 나타내면 된다. 정확한 함수 관계를 얻지 못해도 그래프를 그릴 수 있으며 이런 그림도 채점한다.

entries.source: Let us now consider the second experiment on the passage of a monopole through the superconducting ring. Let the monopole move with a constant velocity [[0]] along the axis of the superconducting ring. In contrast, we consider this experiment in the reference frame associated with the monopole. Let us direct the coordinate axis [[1]] along the axis of the ring, its origin is coincident with the monopole, so that the coordinate of the ring [[2]] changes from [[3]] to [[4]].
entries.ko: 두 번째로 자기홀극이 초전도 고리를 통과하는 실험을 생각하자. 자기홀극은 고리 축을 따라 일정한 속도 [[0]]로 움직인다. 이번에는 자기홀극에 고정된 기준계에서 다룬다. 좌표축 [[1]]을 고리 축 방향으로 잡고 원점을 자기홀극에 두면 고리 좌표 [[2]]는 [[3]]에서 [[4]]로 변한다.

entries.source: Quantization of magnetic flux in superconductors

Quantum theory shows that free electrons in a superconductor combine into bound pairs that move as a single unit (such pairs are called Cooper pairs). To describe their motion, one can use a semiclassical approximation: Newton's equations are supplemented with Bohr's quantization rule, which in this case states that the angular momentum [[0]] of a pair relative to the ring center can only take integer values that are multiples of the reduced Planck constant [[1]].
entries.ko: 양자이론에 따르면 초전도체의 자유전자는 결합한 쌍인 쿠퍼쌍을 이루어 하나처럼 움직인다. 운동은 뉴턴 방정식에 보어 양자화 규칙을 더하는 준고전 근사로 기술할 수 있다. 여기서는 고리 중심에 대한 쌍의 각운동량 [[0]]이 디랙 상수 [[1]]의 정수배만 가능하다는 규칙이다.

entries.source: 3.10 Express the change in the angular momentum of an electron pair [[0]] moving along a circular superconducting ring through the change in the magnetic flux of the external magnetic field through the ring [[1]].
entries.ko: 3.10 원형 초전도 고리를 따라 움직이는 전자쌍의 각운동량 변화 [[0]]를 고리를 지나는 외부 자기선속 변화 [[1]]로 나타내라.

entries.source: 3.11 Find the minimum possible change in the magnetic flux of the external field through the ring, which is called the quantum of magnetic flux [[0]] and calculate its numerical value.
entries.ko: 3.11 고리를 지나는 외부 자기선속의 가능한 최소 변화량인 자기선속 양자 [[0]]를 구하고 수치를 계산하라.

entries.source: 3.12 Find the change in current in the ring [[0]] when the magnetic flux through it changes by 1 quantum [[1]].
entries.ko: 3.12 자기선속이 1양자 [[1]]만큼 변할 때 고리 전류 변화 [[0]]를 구하라.

entries.source: Estimating the Dirac Monopole Mass By applying the quantization rule to the total magnetic flux generated by the Dirac monopole, we can estimate the magnetic charge and its mass. A Dirac monopole is a monopole with the minimum possible magnetic charge [[0]].
entries.ko:
디랙 자기홀극 질량 추정
디랙 자기홀극이 만드는 총자기선속에 양자화 규칙을 적용하면 자기전하와 질량을 추산할 수 있다. 디랙 자기홀극은 가능한 최소 자기전하 [[0]]를 가진 자기홀극이다.

entries.source: Theoretical physics uses the following model of an electron: it is a spherical particle with a charge uniformly distributed over the surface of a sphere whose radius is called the classical radius of an electron. It is also assumed that the rest mass of an electron is completely determined by the energy of its electrostatic field.
entries.ko: 이론물리에서는 전자를 구 표면에 전하가 균일하게 분포한 구형 입자로 모형화하기도 한다. 이 구의 반지름을 전자의 고전반지름이라 한다. 전자의 정지질량은 정전기장 에너지로 완전히 결정된다고 가정한다.

entries.source: 3.13 Find the numerical value of the minimum magnetic charge of a monopole [[0]].

entries.ko: 3.14 디랙 자기홀극이 초전도 고리를 통과할 때 전류 변화 [[0]]를 구하라.

entries.source: 3.15 Express the classical radius of an electron [[0]] through its mass [[1]], charge [[2]] and fundamental physical constants. Calculate its numerical value.
entries.ko: 3.15 전자의 고전반지름 [[0]]를 질량 [[1]], 전하 [[2]], 기본 물리 상수로 나타내고 수치를 계산하라.

entries.source: 3.16 Assuming that the radius of the monopole is equal to the classical radius of the electron, and its rest mass is determined by the energy of its magnetic field, find the mass ratio of the Dirac monopole [[0]] and of the electron [[1]] and calculate its numerical value.
entries.ko: 3.16 자기홀극 반지름이 전자의 고전반지름과 같고 정지질량이 자기장 에너지로 결정된다고 하라. 디랙 자기홀극 질량 [[0]]과 전자 질량 [[1]]의 비를 구하고 수치를 계산하라.
